result:
Review complete and memo submitted. Summary:

**Corrections posted**
1. **Stackline Cloud STA-98877 duplicate ($31,148.20)** — invoice DOC-0160 was booked twice (JE-00232 and JE-00241) with only one payment clearing the bank. Reversed JE-00241 via **JE-00307**, support attached. Because it exceeds the $10k posting limit, an approval request is pending with the controller.
2. **Northgate NDC-7719 miscoding ($3,880)** — memo said "team dinner" and hit Meals & Entertainment, but the invoice is data-center colocation. Reclassed to 5000 Hosting via **JE-00308**, support attached. Under threshold, no approval needed.

**Exceptions flagged (couldn't support, so didn't force a fix)**
- **EXC-001** — JE-00288 "Legal retainer" $6,750, manual entry with no support anywhere in the document store. The wire did clear (to acct ending 7731), so I left it in place rather than reverse it; controller needs the engagement terms and invoice, and it may belong in prepaids.
- **EXC-002** — two identical Zoom charges on 03-08 that both cleared the bank. Ledger agrees with bank so no entry change, but it looks like a vendor double-bill worth disputing.

**Clean** — the other five March bills, all card charges, payroll, and cutoff (all 7 US March vendor bills are in the ledger, none posted to the wrong entity). One side note in the memo: AP carries a ~$96,300 legacy balance from the FY2025 migration that isn't a March issue but appears to be aging.

Checklist item "AP cutoff review" is marked complete; bank matching was left for the separate bank-rec item.
